outputCopy.heroIntroduction: For residents of Thurnscoe, Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic offers access to the NHS Pharmacy First scheme. This service enables eligible individuals to consult a qualified pharmacist regarding select common health conditions, supporting the community with professional advice and treatment options tailored to personal clinical needs.
outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Thurnscoe is a village situated in the Dearne Valley within the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley, South Yorkshire. Historically shaped by its industrial heritage, particularly coal mining, the area lies north-east of Barnsley and west of Doncaster. Today, it functions predominantly as a residential settlement surrounded by South Yorkshire countryside.

The local environment features notable outdoor spaces, including Phoenix Park—a reclaimed former colliery site transformed into green space—and Thurnscoe Park. Community amenities include local primary schools, community centres, and retail facilities centered along Station Road and Lidgett Lane. Local healthcare provision within the neighbourhood includes GP practices such as Hollygreen Practice and Hilltop Surgery, serving the daily health needs of local residents.

To support community health needs, Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic provides Pharmacy First consultations for eligible people from the area. Under Pharmacy First, patients experiencing certain common health conditions can receive a structured clinical assessment. During the consultation, the pharmacist evaluates symptoms, medical history, and any relevant medicines. Depending on this individual assessment, outcomes may involve self-care advice, suitable clinical treatment, or referral to another healthcare professional. Eligibility and any subsequent treatment depend entirely on the individual clinical evaluation.
outputCopy.relationshipToPharmacy: Consultations take place at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield. Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic is approximately 4.9 km in a straight line from Thurnscoe.
